text:
European officials fear US negotiators are echoing Kremlin talking points ahead of this week's Ukraine peace talks in Abu Dhabi.

Critics see Washington's call for a "broader European security architecture" as an early win for Russia.
President Trump says Iran is "dying" to reach an agreement.

Follow up: Iraqi PM Ali al Zaidi spent hours in Tehran on Friday with Speaker Qalibaf, Fars reports, talking only about ending the war with the US.

Qalibaf presented Iran's "two day proposal" and said Washington must respect Iran's rights for talks to advance.
The death toll from a steel plant explosion in Izmir, western Turkey, has climbed to 10, with another 15 people injured, reports say.

More Iranian ballistic missile launches are being reported, the latest spotted near Kuhestan Park in Yazd, central Iran.

The launches may be part of ongoing military drills.

🚨 Vice President JD Vance is expected to meet Mohsen Rezaei, secretary of Iran's Supreme National Security Council, in Doha next week, Turkish intelligence chief Ibrahim Kalin says.

There is no US confirmation so far.
Gulf stock markets gained on Monday on hopes that new strikes on Iran will stay off the table.

Bipartisan support for Israel in Washington is eroding, with voices in both parties pushing for new limits.

Vice President JD Vance is among the Republicans calling for change, while many Democrats want to restrict military aid to Israel.

A judge is expected to set a trial date for Tyler Robinson, the man accused of murdering Charlie Kirk.

The defense is asking for three more years to prepare, and legal analysts say the trial could slip into 2028.

A drone has killed an employee of the Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant, the IAEA says, and another drone killed a worker at the nearby thermal plant.

Days earlier, another plant worker was reportedly killed the same way. IAEA chief Grossi condemned the strikes.

Israeli forces have arrested 10 Islamic Jihad members who were allegedly planning an attack on Israeli civilians in northern Samaria.

Acting on Shin Bet intelligence, troops raided several locations at once in a village in the Menashe area.

Turkey wants to build warships with Egypt under its MILGEM program, modeled on its Pakistan partnership, Turkish Navy chief Ercüment Tatlıoğlu said after joint drills off Alexandria.

The navies also cooperate on Turkish missiles, torpedoes and mines.

Israel's opposition is weighing a coalition deal with the ultra Orthodox parties to topple Netanyahu.

Such a deal would likely force Gadi Eisenkot to walk back his pledge to enforce universal military conscription.

Flyers with a QR code have turned up in mailboxes in northern Tel Aviv, leading to a site run by Handala, an Iran linked hacker group.

It warns: "From south to north, your energy and water arteries will shatter like glass."

Police and the Shin Bet are investigating.

US Central Command chief Adm. Brad Cooper has told senior Israeli military leaders to prepare for a possible third wave of US strikes on Iran, Israel's Channel 13 reports.

Targets could include bridges and power stations. There is no US confirmation so far.
Secretary of State Marco Rubio landed in Paris overnight for the G7 meeting, his first trip abroad since the midterm elections.
Jordan's Foreign Minister Ayman Safadi says Israel must withdraw from all Syrian territory it has occupied since December 8, 2024.

Iran's President Pezeshkian says Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei has ordered an end to the state of "neither war nor peace" with the United States.

Iran is open to dialogue but "will not submit to force and bullying," he said, according to IRNA.

🚨 President Trump has asked Iraq's prime minister to carry proposals to Tehran aimed at ending the Iran war, sources told Al Hadath.

The Iraqi leader, who drafted the ideas and won Trump's approval by phone, led a secret delegation to Tehran.

South African police have arrested nine foreigners aged 20 to 26 who were allegedly about to fly out to fight in the Russia Ukraine war.

They were held at OR Tambo airport and a Johannesburg hotel in an operation involving Interpol.
